scripts.dev:api: echo dev:api is filled in by the API lane && exit 1
scripts.db:migrate: echo db:migrate is filled in by the data-model lane && exit 1
scripts.gen:api: echo gen:api is filled in by the API and web lanes && exit 1
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && pnpm --filter web lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy && pnpm --filter web typecheck
scripts.test: uv run pytest && pnpm --filter web test
